description: This source file is a Markdown document detailing the concept, management, and metadata of subsystems within the Thunder framework. It explains how subsystems like NETWORK, INTERNET, and GRAPHICS are supported, their metadata interfaces, usage within plugins, status checking, notifications, and how they impact plugin lifecycle and dependencies.

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: Implementation of the IInternet interface providing details about the device's public IP address and network type, used for managing and reporting INTERNET subsystem metadata within plugins.

methods.name: InternetInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the InternetInfo object with default IP and network type.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the device's current public IP address.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (UNKNOWN, IPV4, IPV6) of the device's internet connection.
